name: 页页
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: dedicated tiny UI avatar PNG for the reading companion Yeye, displayed at 24 and 32 CSS pixels.
Input image: the approved v7 full-body Yeye is the identity reference. Derive a head-only avatar of this exact character.
Preserve the recognizable large tilted bean-shaped head, slightly asymmetrical round triangle ears, broad warm cream cheek cloud, orange nose, apricot cheek spots, coherent pupils gazing slightly toward viewer-right, attentive clever friendly expression and tiny asymmetric closed smile. Same warm brown #332B25, cream #F7F3EB and baked orange #B65A17 palette. Keep the original soft geometric illustrated character; do not redesign as a different cat.
Composition: a SINGLE isolated head only, both ears and both cheeks fully visible, centered on a square transparent canvas, head occupying about 92% of canvas width with minimal even clear margins. No neck, body, book, paws or tail. Adapt the eye whites, pupils and mouth stroke only as needed to remain unmistakable at 24px; strong simple contours, no fine texture. Avoid adding eyebrow marks, fur detail, accessories, outlines around a badge, or shadows. No circular background or frame, no text, no scenery, no sheet of variants. Clean alpha edges with real transparency, no white fringe.
